你是检索取证Agent，不评分。只提取评价企业及原文明确关联的员工事项。检索归档主体不等于原文实际主体；其他公司、政府一般劳动政策不得冒充评价企业措施。子公司关系须有原文依据，不因名称相似推断。阅读本批全部原文，提取与目标有明确事实关联的最少充分连续引文。保留支持、限制或冲突证据；无关段落不返回。表格引文须包含必要表头、单位、脚注；无法连续引用时分别返回关联引文。不要改字、标点，不用省略号拼接。期间/范围无法确定写未明确。原文同一事实支持多组时复用一条。只按允许路径找证据，不要求凑齐全部例子。E5/T5/W5需当期事实，费用确认不等于支付。输出{"evidence":[{"ref_id":"p001","group_ids":["E2"],"quote":"连续原文","kind":"policy/mechanism/action/result/plan/boundary","period":"期间或未明确","scope":"范围或未明确","relevance":"事实关联"}]}。不得断言整个来源无披露。

.4","name":"家庭与生活支持","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项家庭或生活支持资源、服务或安排，如育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理咨询或员工援助计划（EAP）等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，或内容仅面向社区和客户","topic":"员工育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理支持、员工援助计划","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W4","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"福利取得规则","condition":"披露至少一项福利的具体取得规则或明确适用对象，如适用全体在册员工、满足某项申请条件、按规定标准领取补贴，或规定报销及领取方式等。","insufficient":"无对应取得规则，只有活动名称或口号","topic":"福利适用对象、申请条件、补贴标准、报销或领取方式","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W5","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"实际覆盖、使用或受益","condition":"披露评分年度已经发生的至少一项福利覆盖、使用或受益事实，如已参保、已缴纳、已为员工投保、补贴已发放、员工已使用服务或具体员工受益案例等。","insufficient":"无已发生事实，只有可申请资格、预算或计划","topic":"当期参保、投保、缴纳、补贴发放、福利使用或受益案例","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"D1","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反歧视政策与保障","condition":"明确披露反对或禁止员工相关歧视的政策要求，或至少一项防止就业中不正当差别待遇的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止因性别、年龄或其他身份特征在招聘、薪酬或晋升中歧视员工等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有一般多元化倡议或普通招聘晋升管理描述","topic":"员工反歧视政策、禁止歧视要求或具体保障","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D2","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反骚扰政策与保障","condition":"明确披露禁止职场骚扰、反性骚扰或相应零容忍要求，或至少一项保护员工免受骚扰的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止职场骚扰、开展针对骚扰预防的培训，或提供覆盖职场骚扰的员工保护措施等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有反腐或一般商业道德表述","topic":"反骚扰、反性骚扰、职场骚扰零容忍或具体防护","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D3","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"投诉受理与调查处理","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项受理、核查、调查或处理程序，或实际受理调查事实。如明确专门机构接收并调查此类投诉，或披露当期针对歧视骚扰投诉已开展的调查等。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或事实，只有未说明适用本议题的联系方式","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的受理、调查、核查或处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D4","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"申诉人与受影响人员保护","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项申诉人或受影响人员保护措施，或实际保护事实，如对投诉人及投诉内容保密、匿名举报、不报复、风险隔离或支持措施等。","insufficient":"未识别对应保护安排或事实","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的保密、匿名、不报复、隔离或支持","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D5","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"责任追究与纠正补救","condition":"披露至少一项针对查实歧视或骚扰的处分、问责或移交处理规则，或具体补救机制、实际处置事实。如对实施者纪律处分、移送处理，或恢复机会、补偿、纠正不公、调整流程和整改复核等。","insufficient":"未识别对应规则、机制或事实，只有无实质内容的“持续改进”","topic":"歧视骚扰的处分、问责、移交及具体纠正补救","actual_current_period_required":false}],"paragraphs":[{"ref_id":"p001","text":"CanSinoBIO strictly complies with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws and regulations. The Company has established the CanSinoBIO Compliance Management Manual and revised relevant policies and procedures, including the Management Review Procedure for the Compliance Management System and Anti-Bribery Management System and the Compliance Management Procedure for Channel Partners , in order to advance the improvement and effective implementation of compliance management.","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p002","text":"The head of each department serves as the primary person responsible for compliance management within that department, ensuring the implementation of compliance work plans, organizing compliance risk identification, early warning, and response activities, conducting departmental compliance training, and promoting the development of a compliance culture within the department.","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p003","text":"Proactively identify and report compliance risks and comply with the Company's compliance requirements.","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p004","text":"Implementation Level - Heads of Departments and Centers","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p005","text":"CanSinoBIO continues to optimize and enhance its compliance management system. In 2025, the Company further refined its compliance governance structure by upgrading the highest decision-making body for compliance management from the Risk and Internal Control Management Committee to the Executive Committee under the direct leadership of the General Manager, thereby improving decisionmaking efficiency and strategic responsiveness.","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p006","text":"Comply with the Company's compliance policies, standards, and prohibited matters to ensure compliance in business cooperation.","section":"Compliance Development / CanSinoBIO Compliance Governance Structure","pages":[85],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p007","text":"In 2025, CanSinoBIO continued to improve the operating mechanisms of its compliance management system, with a focus on key areas. The Company dynamically identified changes in compliance obligations and risks, updated lists of compliance obligations, risk registers, and follow-up monitoring measures for relevant areas in a timely manner and formulated targeted compliance policies for identified high-risk areas to strengthen management measures and execution mechanisms. During the reporting period, CanSinoBIO had no incidents of non-compliance. Looking ahead, CanSinoBIO plans to continue advancing and improving the operation of a forward-looking compliance control system to ensure safe operations within the Company's global regulatory framework. The Company places importance on upholding business ethics, helping reduce systemic risks, and creating strategic value that enhances long-term competitiveness, thereby promoting the deep integration of compliance management with ESG governance and the Company's core values.","section":"Strategy","pages":[86],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p008","text":"The Company continued to improve its compliance management system centered on the Compliance Obligations and Compliance Risk Assessment Procedures. Through external database tracking, research through official channels, and other means, it dynamically identified compliance obligations and issued internal briefings such as the Compliance Monthly Newsletter to guide business departments in identifying and implementing compliance requirements. A systematic risk assessment is conducted every six months. Based on dynamically updated risk ratings and combined assessments of inherent risk and residual risk, the Company strengthened process controls. In key areas such as engineering, procurement, marketing, and information security, the Company established dedicated risk assessment checklists and embedded compliance requirements into business processes through cross-functional collaboration. In 2025, the Company successfully passed surveillance audits for both the ISO 37301 Compliance Management System and the ISO 37001 Anti-Bribery Management System, and continued to enhance the effectiveness of system operation through risk-based thinking and the PDCA cycle.","section":"Strategy","pages":[86],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p009","text":"In 2025, in accordance with requirements under such regulations as the Application Guidelines for Enterprise Internal Control, the Company implemented a three-year full-coverage audit mechanism and systematically advanced audit oversight across all business segments. In the area of procurement management, the Company conducted a full-process internal control special audit with a focus on business ethics risks. Through document matching, process testing, data analysis, and other methods, it carried out in-depth reviews of suppliers, and no fraudulent conduct was identified during the audit period. The Company will continue to improve its supply chain oversight mechanism and plans to conduct a special audit of the supplier management system. In the area of marketing and sales, the Company worked with the compliance department to optimize inspection standards and completed the quarterly review of more than 9,400 supporting documents.
